programme.title: Kill the Wicked!
programme.desc: Good Samaritan drifter, Benny Hudson and a stranded woman, Jenny finds themselves being torture; when they accidentally walk into an gang's hideout in a ghost town.

programme.title: Brother Outlaw
programme.desc: A man is falsely charged with bank robbery, prompting his brother to break him out of prison.

programme.title: A Minute to Pray, a Second to Die
programme.desc: In Tuscola, New Mexico, the Governor offers amnesty papers to all outlaws but gunfighter Clay McCord's appearance triggers a violent confrontation between the local marshal, McCord, and other outlaws.

programme.title: Dig Your Grave Friend... Sabata's Coming
programme.desc: Steve McGowan returns from war to avenge his father’s murder by a ruthless landowner. Imprisoned, he escapes with a bandit and steals a stagecoach—only to find the villain’s fiancée inside. As hired guns close in, alliances shift, and the fight for justice takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Dynamite Jim
programme.desc: Union soldiers secure a shipment of gold from a sly Mexican banker, but their journey is anything but safe. Crooked outlaws, the treacherous banker himself, and the notorious Dynamite Jim all set their sights on the treasure. Betrayals and ambushes await as the race for the gold heats up.

programme.title: Degueyo
programme.desc: When Ramon's bandits storm Danger City for rumored treasure, they slaughter or capture the men, leaving only women and children to face a ruthless "Deguello" if the money isn’t found. Four determined men, already hunting Ramon, join forces to help the town defend itself.

programme.title: Requiescant
programme.desc: The adopted son of a preacher comes upon a village that is under the thumb of a deranged ex-Confederate officer, who is - among other things - stealing land from the locals with phony land grants.

programme.title: Heads or Tails
programme.desc: Shanda is charged with the murder of the banker, Burton and to save her from being lynched, the sheriff sends her off to Phoenix. During the trip the two deputies to whom she’s been entrusted rape and leave her in the desert, certain that she’s dead. The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: Sugar Colt
programme.desc: In order to avenge a friend and to fulfill his last wish, Rocco has to find out what happened to an army corps that has mysteriously disappeared. He therefore puts on the disguise of a doctor and starts investigating in a somewhat uncomfortable town.

programme.title: The White, the Yellow and the Black
programme.desc: In the 19th century, when the Japanese Emperor sends a gift pony to the US President it gets stolen and ransomed by Indians but Sheriff Gideon aided by an inept Japanese servant offers to deliver the ransom.

programme.title: May God Forgive You... But I Won't
programme.desc: While Cjamango is away from his ranch six bandits attack and kill all the members of his family.

programme.title: They Call Me Hallelujah
programme.desc: In revolutionary Mexico, General Ramirez hires the enigmatic gunfighter Hallelujah to intercept a fortune in jewels meant to fund Emperor Maximilian’s weapons. His mission spirals into chaos as he faces bandits, spies, impostors, and schemers in a wild chase through danger and deception.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Two outlaws, "The Doctor" and the Indian Girolamo, help a village fight a gang and a corrupt sheriff who has discovered gold beneath the town.

programme.title: Tepepa
programme.desc: In early 20th-century Mexico, the guerrilla leader Tepepa is saved from execution by Doctor Price, an Englishman. Tepepa, a hero of the Revolution, is curious about the doctor’s motives. The chilling answer: to kill him himself. A deadly game of cat and mouse begins between Tepepa and the ruthless police chief, Cascorro.
